claims.value: Olmo 3 7B RL-Zero Code is an experimental Transformer-based autoregressive language model for scientific exploration of RLVR training on coding tasks, developed by Allen Institute for AI.
claims.evidence: The RL-Zero family of models is an experimental set of model for the scientific exploration of RLVR training.
claims.section: Model Card for Olmo 3 7B RL-Zero Code

claims.evidence: Model type: a Transformer style autoregressive language model.

claims.value: The model is post-trained on the Dolci-RLZero-Code-7B dataset using reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR).
claims.evidence: reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-RL-Zero-Code-7B dataset which consists of coding queries.

claims.value: The model is based on the allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B base model.
The model is licensed under Apache 2.0 and intended for research and educational use.
claims.evidence: License: This model is licensed under Apache 2.0. It is intended for research and educational use

claims.value: The knowledge cutoff date for the model is December 2023.
